what: The engine's force error at the configuration the acceptance thresholds are defined at, so it is comparable with them.
produced_by: npm run report:engine-error, which drives web/validate.html in Chrome
host: Apple M3 Pro, macOS 14, Google Chrome, apple · metal-3

force_relative_rms._definition: sqrt(sum((a-b)^2) / sum(b^2)) over all 3N components; the identical formula in src/gpu/verify.ts and tools/calibrate_thresholds.py, which is what makes these comparable

total_energy.note: The asymmetry between forces and total energy is real and is not a defect: forces accumulate exactly in 64-bit fixed point, whereas the total is a difference of two large cancelling PME terms, so its relative error is amplified by the cancellation.
